note: Templates from real 122M logs. Tests explicitly construct synthetic 300M trajectories; these are not 300M results.

reader.file_resolution: pinned dataset card train globs, Parquet paths only
reader.row_order: stored row order within each Parquet file

metadata.selection: seeded buffer shuffle; stop at document limit or after the whole document reaching the train-token target
metadata.split_rule: sha256(seed + NUL + original UTF-8 text), first 64 bits below val_fraction * 2**64
metadata.text_processing: skip whitespace-only documents; otherwise preserve text unchanged
